description: Show the X-Matrix to the person, in the conversation: the matrix drawn (vision at the bottom by default) and a card per initiative (health, why, expected result and its KPI, milestones, next action, a button to its page). Hosts that support MCP Apps (claude.ai on the web) display it; elsewhere you get the same content as text. It is the plain reference view: to build your own presentation, read get_matrix_data. Pass audience "external" when the screen is shared with people outside the organization.

audience.description: internal (default) or external: the filter of a public link

lang.description: Language of the labels (default: the account language)

matrix_id.description: UUID of the matrix (default: the default matrix of the organization)

orientation.description: bottom (default): vision at the bottom; top: as the app

name: show_matrix
title: Show the X-Matrix
